Name: Refine Your Forage -- Simple Artisan Forage
Author: Cheerybelle
Description:
[color=#ffe599]"Refine Your Forage" allows different forage items to be refined at the Preserves Jar and the Keg without changing their item categories.[/color]

[b][color=#a4c2f4][size=2]With this mod, the following items can be turned into both juice and pickles:[/size][/color]
[color=#E0CBF2]Truffle[/color]
[color=#b6d7a8]Seaweed[/color]
[color=#fff2cc]Green Algae
White Algae[/color][/b]

[color=#a4c2f4][b]...and the following items can be turned into juice [/b][size=1](They could already be turned into pickles.)[/size][b]:[/b][/color]
[color=#f4cccc][b]Common Mushroom
Morel
Chanterelle
Purple Mushroom
Magma Cap[/b][/color]

 If you don't want a subset of the above recipes, they have been split into 4 sub-mods [size=1](Truffle, Seaweed, Algae, Mushroom Juice, colour-coded above)[/size] within the main mod folder, so you can just delete any you don't want.
Also, the addons listed below are standalone, and you don't need any of the core Refine Your Forage mod to use them.

[color=#fce5cd]The addon, [b]Dried Truffles[/b], allows turning [b]Truffles[/b] into Dried Truffles. (only for 1.6 onwards)[/color]
[color=#d9d2e9]The bonus addon, [b]Bonus: Poisonous Forage[/b], allows turning [b]Holly[/b] into jelly and wine and turning [b]Red Mushrooms[/b] into pickles and juice.[/color]
[color=#ea9999]The bonus addon, [b]Bonus: Dry Poison[/b], allows turning [b]Holly[/b] into Dried Hollies and [b]Red Mushrooms[/b] into Dried Red Mushrooms. (only for 1.6 onwards)[/color]
[color=#ffe599]The bonus addon, [b]Bonus: Daffodils[/b], allows turning [b]Daffodils[/b] into jelly and wine.[/color]

[color=#a4c2f4]The bonus addon, [b]Bonus: 1.5.6 Backport[/b], is for users of Stardew Valley 1.5.6, and it allows said users to refine forage that can be refined in the vanilla game in Stardew Valley 1.6.x.
[b][size=2]The following items can be turned into pickles and juice:[/size][/b][/color][b]
[color=#b6d7a8]Wild Horseradish
Leek
Cave Carrot
Spring Onion
Winter Root
Snow Yam[/color]
[color=#f9cb9c]Hazelnut[/color]
[color=#ffe599]Dandelion[/color]
[color=#a4c2f4][size=2]...the following items can be turned into pickles:[/size][/color]
[color=#f4cccc]Common Mushroom
Morel
Chanterelle
Purple Mushroom
Magma Cap[/color]
[color=#a4c2f4][size=2]...and...[/size][/color]
[color=#d9ead3]Ginger[/color][/b][color=#d9ead3] [size=2]can be turned into [b]juice[/b].[/size][/color]

As of Release 4, products use their ingredients' dye colours.

Release 2 (Stardew 1.5.6) Info
[spoiler][b][color=#a4c2f4][size=2]With this mod, the following items can be turned into both juice and pickles:[/size][/color]
[color=#b6d7a8]Wild Horseradish
Leek
Cave Carrot
Spring Onion
Winter Root
Snow Yam[/color]
[color=#f9cb9c]Hazelnut[/color]
[color=#f4cccc]Common Mushroom
Morel
Chanterelle
Purple Mushroom
Truffle[/color]
[color=#ffe599]Dandelion[/color]
[color=#b6d7a8]Seaweed[/color]
[color=#fff2cc]Green Algae
White Algae[/color]
[color=#f4cccc]Magma Cap[/color][/b]

[color=#d9ead3][b]Ginger[/b] can also now be turned into juice. (It could already be pickled.)[/color]

[color=#d9d2e9]In addition, [b]Holly[/b] can be turned into jelly, and [b]Red Mushrooms[/b] can be turned into pickles.
There is a bonus addon (Bonus: Poisonous Forage) if you want to turn them into wine and juice.[/color]

[color=#ffe599][b]Daffodils[/b][/color][color=#ffe599] cannot be refined by default, but there is a bonus addon that allows you to make them into jelly and wine.[/color]
[color=#d8d8d8][size=1][/spoiler]

(If you notice any issues with the mod, please let me know.)[/size][/color]

This mod was created as an alternative to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4674][u]More Than Forage[/u][/url], but both can be used at the same time if you so desire.
If you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080][u]Better Artisan Good Icons (BAGI)[/u][/url], BAGI support is included in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5220][u]Style-Compromise Artisan Good Icons[/u][/url].
